name: The Vertical Compact
description: A prestige neural-feed drama set entirely within the Spire's executive tier, following the interlocking political and personal lives of three rival corponation family dynasties across a single fiscal year. The show is notable for its cold, procedural immersion style — you inhabit characters who are never the protagonist, always the person watching from the edge of the room — and for its refusal to render any character as straightforwardly sympathetic. Produced by a Vantablack subsidiary with unusual creative autonomy, it won the Meridian Feed Award for immersive drama in 2216.
cultural_impact: Popularized the 'observer immersion' narrative format, in which the audience never inhabits the most powerful person in a scene — a technique now widely imitated in neural-feed drama.
story_hooks: A current Spire executive has contacted the show's writers claiming that Season 3's leaked script contains accurate information about an ongoing internal Sable Charter succession crisis — information the writers insist they invented.
The show's neural-feed immersion data is being harvested by a third party; audience emotional responses to specific Spire power dynamics are being sold to actual corponation PR firms.
One of the show's three fictional dynasties is based on a real family that was quietly destroyed in a corporate consolidation — a surviving member wants the story told accurately, or not at all.
